title: Travel: John Lennon – Cayman Islands to New York | 1978
content:
John Lennon, Yoko Ono, and Sean Lennon returned to New York from the Cayman Islands on 1 June 1978.

They had travelled to the Caribbean territory for a holiday on 7 May.
